elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The Company owns “all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement.”

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI “hereby assigns the same to the Company.”

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that “HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property.”

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company retains “all rights” in the defined Company Data, covering Content, user information, and other data belonging to, supplied by, or collected or processed for the Company.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Any HDI license in Company Data is expressly limited to processing it solely to provide the services under the Agreement.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause states: “No intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the Parties.”

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly retains its pre-existing intellectual property, encompassing its pre-existing generic tools and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Company receives ownership of all right, title, and interest in the deliverables without a time limit, which is stronger than a perpetual license.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: HDI assigns all right, title, and interest in the deliverables without a revocation right, which is stronger than an irrevocable license.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The unrestricted assignment of “all right, title and interest” contains no territorial limitation and is stronger than a worldwide license.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Company receives ownership by assignment with no royalty obligation, which is stronger than a royalty-free license.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Ownership of all right, title, and interest permits the Company to use and modify the deliverables without a business-use restriction.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: As owner of all right, title, and interest, the Company may license or sublicense rights in the deliverables for its business.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Any HDI license in Company Data is expressly limited to processing it solely to provide the services under the Agreement.
